title: 84 ## Persons arrested per case Table 25 presents statistics of number of persons arrested per case under different heads of crime under the Indian Penal Code and also under Local and Special Laws during 1969 to 1973. Among the IPC Crime, the number of persons arrested per case was the highest in case of Riots (5·61) followed by Dacoity (4·27) as against the average of all the IPC Crime as 1·28. The number of persons arrested in case of Burglary and Thefts per case was the lowest (0·59). Under the Local and Special Laws the number of persons arrested per case was the highest in case of Gambling Act (1·74) followed by Explosive Act and Explosive Substance Act (1·33). For all other offences it was around (1·00). The pattern during 1973 was more or less the same as during 1972.
